researchQuestion: Does an official Taiwan general-news provider expose an authorized Traditional-Chinese news-text product lane sufficient to move D17-08 from theory toward a measurement benchmark without assuming production/commercial rights or PIT completeness?

evidence.finding: CNA explicitly offers licensed Chinese-news products to subscribers and describes rapid delivery of collected, reported and translated news.
CNA MCP is a paid subscription product that can search CNA data; the page also exposes a separate Team/organization contact lane.
CNA states MCP subscription can connect AI applications to its database and spans institutions, schools and individuals.

support: A first-party paid/authorized access lane exists; D17-08 is no longer blocked by absence of any identifiable Traditional-Chinese general-news product candidate.
CNA product materials support an explicit distinction between consumer/small-workflow subscription and organization/team arrangements.
falsification: A subscription product page does not prove System 2 commercial-production, redistribution, storage, derivative-training or bulk-export rights.
Searchable database access does not prove exhaustive event denominator, low-latency feed semantics, immutable historical versions or first-availability timestamps.
CNA may include translated wire content; source lineage must remain separate from delivery endpoint.
No article text has been used to label stock direction and no return outcome has been opened.

pit.rule: Displayed publication time is not strategy knownAt unless prospective first-observation is authenticated.

decision.reason: Authorized product candidate is bounded, but exact text fields/rights, exhaustive denominator, prospective first-observation latency and Traditional-Chinese entity-level annotation reliability are not yet validated.

exactNextContinuationPoint: Validate the actual CNA MCP/authorized-product terms and returned text fields for the intended research/production use; preserve query/pagination/coverage receipts. If rights and fields are sufficient, build an outcome-closed Traditional-Chinese target-entity double-blind annotation benchmark before any prospective PIT/OOS return test.
